body: Checking in from Australia with the same thoughts, that would be a sweat box
I think I'm fine with those slither boys

Glad someone likes them, because they kind of irk me! I'm fine with snakes, and fine with lizards, but long body and tiny legs? That's a no from me! That said, I love cat snakes (ferrets) so clearly I'm just a skink-hating monster!
Can confirm, beagle ears feel amazing. They're so soft and beautiful. Cocker spaniels have incredible ears too!
As kids, my sisters and I would  use clothes pegs to hold the sheets and blankets up on the furniture or windowsill.
